pages.text: The $(l)Void Ring$() combines the Black Hole Band and the Gem of Eternal Density into one ring. Craft it from those two items and Red Matter. It fits the ring curio slot.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)It does everything both parent items do: it pulls nearby drops and condenses items into your chosen material.$(li)Press $(l)C$() to teleport to the block you are looking at, up to 64 blocks away. If you are not looking at a block, it teleports you 32 blocks in the direction you face. Teleporting has a half-second cooldown and unmounts you.$(li)On a pedestal it acts like the Black Hole Band, filling nearby inventories.
